title: "Analyzing Americans' Time Use"
author: "cadenhons13"
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(DBI)
library(duckdb)
library(dbplyr)
```

```{r}
con <- dbConnect(
  duckdb(),
  dbdir = "data/atus.duckdb",
  read_only = TRUE
)

dbplyr_act <- tbl(con, "activities")
dbplyr_resp <- tbl(con, "respondents")
dbplyr_codes <- tbl(con, "activity_codes")
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
activity_avg <- dbplyr_resp |>
  filter(
    day_type == "Weekday",
    employment_status == "Not in labor force"
  ) |>
  select(tucaseid, sex) |>
  inner_join(dbplyr_act, by = "tucaseid") |>
  inner_join(
    select(dbplyr_codes, activity_code, major_name),
    by = "activity_code"
  ) |>
  group_by(tucaseid, sex, major_name) |>
  summarize(total_minutes = sum(duration_min, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  collect() |>
  group_by(sex, major_name) |>
  summarize(mean_minutes = mean(total_minutes, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
```

```{r}
selected_categories <- c(
  "Personal Care Activities",
  "Household Activities",
  "Work & Work-Related Activities",
  "Socializing, Relaxing, and Leisure"
)

hourly_avg <- dbplyr_resp |>
  filter(
    day_type == "Weekday",
    employment_status == "Not in labor force"
  ) |>
  select(tucaseid, sex) |>
  inner_join(dbplyr_act, by = "tucaseid") |>
  inner_join(
    select(dbplyr_codes, activity_code, major_name),
    by = "activity_code"
  ) |>
  filter(major_name %in% selected_categories) |>
  collect() |>
  mutate(hour = floor(start_hhmm / 100)) |>
  filter(hour >= 6, hour <= 23) |>
  group_by(tucaseid, sex, major_name, hour) |>
  summarize(total_minutes = sum(duration_min, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(sex, major_name, hour) |>
  summarize(mean_minutes = mean(total_minutes, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

hourly_avg
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 7
activity_avg |>
  filter(major_name != "Data Codes") |>
  mutate(major_name = fct_reorder2(
    major_name,
    mean_minutes,
    sex,
    .fun = function(x, y) mean(x)
  )) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = major_name, y = mean_minutes, fill = sex)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Daily Time Use by Major Activity",
    subtitle = "Mean weekday minutes for respondents not in the labor force",
    x = "Major activity category",
    y = "Average minutes per diary day",
    fill = "Sex",
    caption = "Source: American Time Use Survey data, stored in data/atus.duckdb"
  )
```
